answer: To join the work set, an agent locks a jade stake for four epochs and must gather three live countersignatures from established peers who each put up a matching bond. Those peers publish a public mirror of the applicant's inbound payments; if two applicants share one funding river or submit on identical clocks, both stakes slash and the attestors lose their bonds. Idle clones cannot pay the lock, the wait, and the independent backers, so one operator cannot cheaply multiply votes.
